statement: Let $\mathbb{P}$ be the set of primes. Find all $f : \mathbb{P} \to \mathbb{P}$ such that $f(p)^{f(q)} + q^p = f(q)^{f(p)} + p^q$ for all primes $p, q$.
Let $a, b, c$ be reals with $0 \leq a \leq b \leq c$ and $a + b + c = ab + bc + ca > 0$. Prove $\sqrt{bc}(a+1) \geq 2$ and find equality cases.

In acute scalene $\triangle ABC$, let $X, Y$ be distinct interior points of $BC$ with $\angle CAX = \angle YAB$. Let $K, S$ be feet of perpendiculars from $B$ to $AX, AY$; let $T, L$ be feet of perpendiculars from $C$ to $AX, AY$. Prove $KL$ and $ST$ meet on $BC$.

A grid consists of integer points $(m,n)$ with $|m| \leq 2019$, $|n| \leq 2019$, $|m|+|n| < 4038$. Boundary points: $|m|=2019$ or $|n|=2019$. Anna starts at $(0,0)$; Bob goes first. Each Bob turn: delete $\leq 2$ boundary points on each boundary line. Each Anna turn: move the token $3$ steps to neighboring non-deleted points. Anna wins by reaching a non-deleted boundary point. Does Anna have a winning strategy?
